title: Gaps in the Rock Record
tagline: Inspect what rock records, what preservation removes, and what evidence can support
hub_blurb: Read synthetic rock layers, find evidence for missing intervals, and practice claims that stop where the local record stops.
card_blurb: Sample authored rock columns, expose anchor-supported missing intervals, and separate a local disappearance from a claim of extinction.
description: **Gaps in the Rock Record** (Missing Time) — an offline rock-record investigation. Students inspect surviving layers, reveal synthetic chronology anchors for missing intervals, sample fossils, compare a second local section, and practice conclusions limited to visible evidence.
